  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FOURTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION) DEGREE  
  EXAMINATIONS - JUNE/JULY 2023  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2252/ECE_2252 - ELECTROMAGNETIC WAVES  
  ELECTRO MAGNETIC WAVES [ECE 2252]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  1A)          Using Gauss law, derive expressions for Electric field intensity due to a uniform line  
  charge and uniform surface charge, both of infinite extent.                                  (4)  
  
  1B)          Determine Electric field (E) and Electric flux density(D) at point P (6,8, -10) caused by  
  a point charge of 30 mC at the origin in free space.                                         (3)  
  
  $$1C)          An electric field is expressed in rectangular coordinates by E =x2 ax+ 6yay +4azV/m.$$  
  Find: (a) VMN if points M and N are specified by M (2, 6, -1) and N (-3, -3, 2); (b) VM (3)  
  $$if V = 0 at Q (4, -2, -35); (c) VN if V = 2 at P (1, 2, -4).$$  
  
  2A)          Find magnetic field intensity on the axis of a circular current loop of radius 'a' using Biot  
  Savart's law.                                                                                 (4)  
  
  2B)          Derive the expression for the boundary conditions between two magnetic medias.  
  (3)  
  
  2C)          Within a certain region, ε = 10-11 F/m and μ = 10-5 H/m. If Bx = 2 x 10-4 cos 105t sin  
  10-3y T,  
  i) Find electric field intensity.                                                           (3)  
  ii) Find the total magnetic flux passing through the surface x = 0, 0 < y < 40 m, 0 < z < 2  
  $$m at t = 1 \mu s.$$  
  
  3A)          Starting from Maxwell's equations, derive Vector wave equation in terms of E for  
  conducting media, assuming plane wave propagation. Obtain solution of the wave               (4)  
  equation when σ>>ωε (good conductors). Also derive the expression of H.  
  
  $$3B)          A wave propagating in lossless material has E = 500 cos (107 t-\beta z) ax V/m and H = 1.1$$  
  cos (107 t-βz) ay. If the wave is travelling at velocity v =c/2 (where c is velocity of light  
  (3)  
  in free space), find  
  (a) μr (b) εr (c) β (d) λ (e) η  
  
  3C)          State and prove Poynting theorem.  
  (3)

  4A)           Derive the expression for the reflection coefficient of uniform plane wave with normal  
  incidence.                                                                                  (4)  
  
  4B)           Three vertices of a triangle are located at A(6, -1, 2), B(-2, 3, -4) and C(-3, 1, 5). Find  
  the cross-product RAB × RAC and the area of the triangle ABC.                               (3)  
  
  $$4C)           Transform the vector A = yax - xay + zaz into cylindrical coordinates.$$  
  (3)  
  
  5A)           Derive the second order differential equations for voltage and current in a transmission  
  line and obtain their solutions in trigonometric form.                                      (4)  
  
  5B)           If the characteristic impedance of a transmission line is 50 Ω, load impedance is 10 + j20  
  Ω and phase constant is 12 rad/m, compute the reflection coefficient at the load-end and (3)  
  impedance at a distance 20 cm from the load, without using Smith chart.  
  
  5C)           Design a single-stub matching network using Smith chart to match a load of 20 - j20 Ω  
  in a transmission line with characteristic impedance of 50 Ω if the operating frequency is (3)  
  30 MHz.
